v01.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished environment concept illustration for the mid-level rest stop of DeepSleep, a 2D free-flight cooperative game. Ultra-wide 3:1 landscape. A modest, welcoming lived-in Chinese residential rooftop at dusk, overlooking a small winding river, nearby tiled-roof village on the left and a distant aspirational modern skyline on the right. Detailed hand-painted anime background, natural straight architectural perspective, gentle blue-lavender shadows, peach-apricot horizon, fine pink clouds, warm windows, hopeful and quietly wistful. Match a calm countryside river dusk aesthetic, not cyberpunk. Composition is designed for gameplay: sky and distant view occupy upper 70 percent, rooftop occupies lower 25-30 percent, a low parapet and shallow visible floor, not an enormous foreground building. In the CENTRAL 55 percent of the entire panorama arrange three small readable areas: left a plain desk holding an old cream CRT computer beneath a small simple weather cover; middle two simple chairs and a little table with thermos and cup, generous clear standing/flying space between furnishings; right a modest rooftop stairwell entrance with warm doorway light. A small water tank, slender TV aerial and a few potted plants provide ordinary life details without clutter. All three functional areas must fit within a centered 16:9 crop of this 3:1 image. Outer left/right margins are expendable extended roof and landscape for wider phone screens and camera overscan, not essential interaction locations. Camera near roof height with a slight downward view onto floor, level horizon and restrained depth, no extreme vanishing point or distorted building. Keep upper and central flying space airy, no characters or creatures, no fantasy portals, temple, luxury rooftop bar, ruined slum, UI, letters, logos or watermark. One coherent full-scene concept, not a sprite sheet, not a collage, not a looping tile. Opaque image.
v01.result: Rejected composition: rooftop too large, stairwell outside shared 16:9 view.
